Resolves #21614

Related: #21346, #21140, #21613

Adds `examples/scheduler/dragAndResize` ("Depot dispatch"): a 10-van, 36-stop delivery day (`07:00–19:00 UTC`) backed by `Neo.data.Store`s of `VanModel` and `StopModel` records, with cross-resource drag reassignment, edge resizing clamped at `minimumDuration: 30` (`enableResizingAcrossOppositeEdge: false`), a custom segmented snap-grid toolbar switcher (`5m`, `15m`, `30m`, `60m`), and a live status bar reporting instructions at rest, live preview telemetry in flight (`Moving` / `Resizing`), and committed edits (`"Stop 14 → Van 3, 10:15 to 10:45"`).

**Keyboard controls (AC-3):** With focus on any `.neo-timeline-bar` (`tabIndex="0"`), `ArrowLeft` / `ArrowRight` moves `[startDate, endDate]` by `±timeAxis.snapMinutes`; `Shift+ArrowLeft` / `Shift+ArrowRight` resizes `endDate` by `±timeAxis.snapMinutes` clamped to `minimumDuration` (`30` minutes); `Escape` aborts an in-flight pointer drag or resize without mutating the record.

**Catalog record for #21613 (Rule 4 — zero shared files touched here):**
- `id`: `'scheduler-drag-and-resize'`
- `name`: `'Re-plan a day by drag'`
- `url`: `'examples/scheduler/dragAndResize/index.html'`
- `feature`: `'Bookings that move between resources, stretch, and snap to a grid you choose'`
- `lookFor`: `'Drag a stop onto another van, then pull its right edge: it lands on the 15-minute grid. Switch the grid to 30 minutes and try again.'`
- Cover state: `drag-and-resize-1440x900-dark-moved.jpg` (`Stop 14 → Van 3, 10:15 to 10:45` in the status line).

Evidence: L3 (local Chromium Playwright e2e + 5-theme responsive verification + dark-theme frame captures + two swapped-order zero-context cold reads at `8972422a61` + Round-2 no-op gesture assertions at `63d2bd1599`) → L3 required (AC-1 through AC-7 cover runtime interaction, responsive theme rendering, and Look evaluation; catalog publication is owned post-merge by #21613).

## Deltas from ticket
- Set `enableResizingAcrossOppositeEdge: false` on `Scheduler` so dragging a stop's right handle past `startDate` clamps cleanly at `minimumDuration: 30` instead of flipping start/end backwards.
- Kept `DragAndResize.spec.mjs` free of the external-Brain fixture token so `test/playwright/externalBrainSelection.mjs` needs zero edits under Rule 4 while `e2e-engine` runs the spec in CI immediately (`E2eCiSelection.spec.mjs` + `externalBrainSelection.spec.mjs` `35/35` green).
- Iterated once on our first cold-look read (`8.5/10` desktop, `6.0/10` mobile) by placing `Stop 14` at `07:15–07:45` so the prompted stop is immediately visible on both `390 × 844` and `1440 × 900`, keeping the 3-category legend + 4 snap buttons on one compact mobile row, and lifting `.neo-scheduler-drag-preview` over a dashed `0.38`-opacity `.neo-scheduler.neo-is-dragging .neo-timeline-bar:focus` origin footprint (`6.0 → 8.0` mobile, `8.5 → 9.0` desktop).

Frame critique: All 10 vans fit vertically without scrolling (`~88 px` of bottom margin below `Van 10` at `1440 × 900` and full fit at `390 × 844`), every visible `Stop 1`–`Stop 36` label renders whole without ellipsis truncation (even at the 30-minute `Stop 14` minimum), and `Stop 14` plus an open `Van 3` drop window are visible on initial paint at both sizes. Because the 12-hour `07:00–19:00 UTC` axis uses `pxPerMinute: 2.2` (`132 px/h`) so 15-minute snap steps (`33 px`) are visually unmistakable, the timeline scrolls horizontally past `~16:45` at `1440 × 900` (`Stop 19`, `Stop 23`, `Stop 30` clip at the right viewport edge) and past `~08:50` at `390 × 844`, with macOS overlay scrollbars hidden at rest; on `390 × 844` the `Snap grid` text caption and right-hand `15-min grid · 30-min min` metadata hide so the 3-item legend and `[5m | 15m | 30m | 60m]` segmented control stay on one unbroken row.
